summary: hostname takes the required name (an unresolvable FQDN causes a short hang) and an optional use strategy; specify systemd for EL7+ and redhat for older systems, since autodetection can fail in containers.
questions: Why does setting the hostname hang for a few seconds?
Which strategy should I use for RHEL 8?
Why does hostname autodetection fail in containers?

answer_card.title: hostname parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name` (required): an FQDN that doesn't resolve causes a few-second hang
- `use`: strategy (`systemd`, `redhat`, `debian`, `alpine`, `openrc`, `macos`, `freebsd`, ...). Use `systemd` for EL7+, `redhat` for older. Set explicitly in containers.
